 WBBL 2026: Match 30, SS W vs PS W Match Prediction – Who will win today’s WBBL match between Sydney Sixers Women vs Perth Scorchers Women?
 Sydney Sixers Women (SS W) take on Perth Scorchers Women (PS W) at the North Sydney Oval in Sydney on Saturday, November 21.
 By Adreej Kumar Mitra Published - 20 Nov 2026, 20:43 IST 
 6 Min Read
 Sydney Sixers Women and Perth Scorchers Women. (Photo Source: Twitter, Santanu Banik/Speed Media/Icon Sportswire via Getty Images) Sydney Sixers Women (SS W) take on Perth Scorchers Women (PS W) at the North Sydney Oval in Sydney on Saturday, November 21.
 This is a clash of the table-toppers. Sydney Sixers are positioned at the top of the points table, having won six games and lost one in seven. They have a net run rate of +1.279. In their most recent clash, they defeated the Adelaide Strikers by nine wickets.
 Perth Scorchers, on the other hand, have also won six games in seven. However, their net run rate is +0.854. They are coming into this clash on the back of a 28-run victory against the Hobart Hurricanes on Thursday. Beth Mooney and Co. would be eager to move to the top of the table with a win in the upcoming clash.

 Probable Top Performers from SS W vs PS W
 Probable Best Batter: Ellyse Perry 
 Ellyse Perry has been in good form this season. The experienced campaigner has scored 282 runs in seven matches at an average of 70.50 and a strike rate of 121.03. She has registered three half-centuries so far in the campaign.
 Probable Best Bowler: Ashleigh Gardner
 Ashleigh Gardner has done well with the ball. She is the leading wicket-taker, having bagged 17 scalps in seven matches at an average of 11.35. The Australian stalwart's economy rate is 8.33. She will hold the key through the middle overs.
